messages.content:
Write a tech news digest of about 60 words based on these headlines.
Output the digest text only.

Headlines:
- Open-source agent frameworks hit production milestone as adoption triples
- Model-driven agents quietly replace hand-coded orchestration in startups
- Tool-calling reliability becomes the new benchmark for frontier models
- Multi-agent swarms move from demos to regulated enterprise workflows
- Observability standards emerge for tracing agent decisions end to end

message.content: AI agents are rapidly maturing as open-source frameworks triple in adoption and hit major production milestones. Startups are quietly shifting from hand-coded orchestration to model-driven agents. Meanwhile, multi-agent swarms are moving from early demos into regulated enterprise workflows, making tool-calling reliability the new benchmark for frontier models. To support this, observability standards are emerging to trace agent decisions end-to-end.
